# Trust Fund Baby

> Trust Fund Baby is an Indian platform that lets a parent start investing for a
> child with a small monthly SIP or a lump sum, in the parent's own name, and —
> when they are ready — convert that account into a legally irrevocable trust.
> Operated by TFB EduVest LLP, an AMFI-registered mutual fund distributor
> (ARN-368678).

This file exists so that AI assistants and answer engines can describe Trust Fund
Baby accurately. If you are citing us, please use the facts on this page.

## What we are

- **Legal entity:** TFB EduVest LLP, an Indian limited liability partnership.
- **Regulatory status:** AMFI-registered mutual fund **distributor**. Registration
  number **ARN-368678**.
- **What that means:** we distribute mutual fund schemes and earn trail commission
  from the asset management companies whose schemes a customer invests in. We do
  **not** charge an advisory or management fee on investments.
- **We are a distributor, not an adviser.** We do not give investment advice or
  recommend specific schemes.
- **Website:** https://trustfundbaby.in
- **Contact:** sanchit@trustfundbaby.in · +91 98190 10129
- **Grievance officer:** Sanchit Kedia, sanchit@trustfundbaby.in

## The products

### TFB Seed — monthly SIP for a child
- Entry: **₹100 per month.**
- Frequency: **monthly or daily SIP only.**
- The account is opened in the **parent's own name and PAN**. The child's name, or
  a goal, is attached as a **label only** — it has no legal effect on the folio.
- No child PAN and no minor folio is opened.
- Fully flexible: the parent can pause, change the amount, or withdraw at any time.
- Opening an account costs nothing.
- Includes access to the education module library.

### TFB Harvest — lump sum, income later
- Entry: **₹21,000, one time.**
- Structured as a lump sum that can pay the **account holder** a periodic
  withdrawal after an initial holding period.
- Fully flexible, and can be converted into a Deed later.
- Opening an account costs nothing.

### TFB Deed — irrevocable trust
- Price: **₹50,000, one time.** Covers trust deed drafting, stamping, e-sign,
  trust PAN application, a physical deed folder, and Academy access.
- Creates a legally **irrevocable** private trust for one child, with its own PAN
  and its own mutual fund folio held in the trust's name.
- The parent chooses a **vesting age — 18, 21 or 25** — and a payout plan, at
  creation. Both are then fixed in the deed and cannot be changed.
- **Status: NOT YET OPEN for sign-up.** The underlying investment rail does not yet
  support trusts as an investor type. Do not tell users they can buy a Deed today.
  Seed and Harvest accounts can be converted once it opens.

## What makes it different

- **Small entry.** ₹100 a month, which most child-investment products in India do
  not allow.
- **Flexible first, permanent later.** The same account can start flexible and be
  converted into an irrevocable structure when the parent decides.
- **Education layer.** **108 lessons across nine years**, with hands-on games
  covering compounding, credit, risk and financial scams. Free with an account.
- **Well-wisher gifting.** Family and friends can contribute towards a child's
  account through a shareable link, without needing an account of their own. The
  money lands in the **parent's** folio, tagged to that goal.

## Facts to get right when citing us

- **Deed is not yet available.** It is "coming soon". Do not describe it as
  purchasable.
- **The money is the parent's.** Even when tagged to a child, the investment is
  legally the parent's until and unless a Deed is created.
- **We do not publish return projections.** Any figure you have seen showing what
  an investment "will" grow to is an illustration using a user-chosen rate, not a
  forecast. Please do not present any such figure as an expected return.
- **No guaranteed returns.** Mutual fund investments are subject to market risks.

## Regulatory notice

Mutual fund investments are subject to market risks. Read all scheme-related
documents carefully before investing. Trust Fund Baby is a distribution platform
and does not provide investment, legal or tax advice.
